leadText:
This article is about Ash's main and temporary traveling companions. If you were looking for a general list of people Ash has met on his journey, see Character of the day.
----
 
Ash's friends are the traveling companions that Ash Ketchum has had with him on his quest to become a Pokémon Master. While he started his alone, many people have joined his party while touring the Pokémon world; usually, at least one new companion joins—and another leaves—every time a new series begins.

Throughout their journey together, Ash and his friends will sometimes be accompanied by temporary companions, who travel with the group for a few episodes without officially joining the main cast. Likewise, Ash also reunites with his previous friends on occasion, who often temporarily rejoin him before parting ways with him again.

In , Ash's friends are not traveling companions, but rather classmates, since Ash is attending the Pokémon School instead of traveling around the Alola region. Later in the series, Ash and his Alolan friends form a team under the supervision of Aether Foundation, known as the Ultra Guardians.

----
 
Ash's friends are the traveling companions that Ash Ketchum has had with him on his quest to become a Pokémon Master. While he started his alone, many people have joined his party while touring the Pokémon world; usually, at least one new companion joins—and another leaves—every time a new series begins.

Throughout their journey together, Ash and his friends will sometimes be accompanied by temporary companions, who travel with the group for a few episodes without officially joining the main cast. Likewise, Ash also reunites with his previous friends on occasion, who often temporarily rejoin him before parting ways with him again.

In , Ash's friends are not traveling companions, but rather classmates, since Ash is attending the Pokémon School instead of traveling around the Alola region. Later in the series, Ash and his Alolan friends form a team under the supervision of Aether Foundation, known as the Ultra Guardians.

==Gallery==
 
 
 

==Original series==
===Misty===
 
 
Misty joined Ash in Pokémon Emergency!, traveling with him because she wanted him to replace her bike, which was destroyed by his . She would consistently travel with him until Gotta Catch Ya Later!, when she returned to Cerulean City to lead her family's Gym nearly full-time. However, she briefly traveled to Hoenn and met up with Ash's Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire group in The Princess and the Togepi and A Togepi Mirage!. Misty met the same group again from The Scheme Team until A Real Cleffa-Hanger, when they accompanied her back home; and also in The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon. After a long absence, she and Brock reappeared in Alola, Kanto! and When Regions Collide!, where Ash and his classmates from the Pokémon School of Alola visited Kanto. She returned in Alola, Alola! and Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone!, where she and Brock visited Melemele Island. She reunited with Ash again in A Fated Face-Off! and both of them decided to travel with each other again until The Rainbow and the Pokémon Master!.

Pokémon
 
 

===Brock===
 
 
Brock first joined Ash in Showdown in Pewter City after Ash d him in the Pewter City Gym. After his father offered to take over the duties of Gym Leader, Brock followed Ash through Kanto, leaving briefly from Poké Ball Peril to A Tent Situation to work for Professor Ivy. In The Rivalry Revival, Brock returned to be with Ash and until Gotta Catch Ya Later!, though he, unlike Misty, would return shortly, in You Can Never Taillow, sticking with Ash until Home is Where the Start is!. He would again return in Two Degrees of Separation!, and so traveled through Sinnoh with Ash until Memories are Made of Bliss!. He and Misty also appeared in Alola, Kanto! and When Regions Collide!, where Ash and his classmates from Pokémon School visited Kanto, and returned in Alola, Alola! and Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone!, where he and Misty visited Alola. Brock reunited with Ash and Dawn in The Arceus Chronicles (Parts 2 to 4), while also meeting Goh for the first time. He reunited with Ash and Misty again in Must Be Our Heroes and the Witch! and all of them decided to travel with each other again until The Rainbow and the Pokémon Master!.

Pokémon
 
 

===Tracey Sketchit===
 
 
After left to work for Professor Ivy, Ash's traveling group was down to two, as it had been for the first five episodes of Kanto. However, this would not last very long, as in The Lost Lapras Ash met a Pokémon Watcher named who essentially invited himself along for the rest of the Orange Islands saga. Traveling with Ash, he wished to attain his ultimate goal of meeting , which he did when Ash returned to Kanto in A Tent Situation. After this, he remained in Pallet Town to be Professor Oak's assistant in The Rivalry Revival. Ash has reunited with Tracey during his visits to Pallet Town in Gotta Catch Ya Later!, The Right Place and the Right Mime, Home is Where the Start Is!, and The Rainbow and the Pokémon Master!.

Pokémon
 
 

==Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire==
===May===
 
 
Ash may have traveled to Hoenn alone; however, shortly after his arrival, he met , a young girl who desired to travel around the world and a fellow Trainer who was just starting her journey and then ended up destroying her bike just like that of Misty. Though she initially did not care for , she eventually found Pokémon Contests, in which she competed while in Hoenn and then later in Kanto. May traveled with Ash through the entire Advanced Generation saga, from Get the Show on the Road to Home is Where the Start Is!, after which she went off to Johto to compete in Contests there. She, like , reappeared briefly during Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl to compete in the Wallace Cup from A Full Course Tag Battle! until Strategy with a Smile!.

Pokémon
 
 

===Max===
 ]]
 
Max is 's younger brother. He does not have any Pokémon of his own because he is too young, but he often befriends certain Pokémon. He traveled with the group from There's no Place Like Hoenn until Home is Where the Start Is, when he went home to Petalburg City. However, he made a promise to Ash that as soon as he got his own Pokémon, he would Ash.

 
 

==Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl==
===Dawn===
 
 
Like his journey into Hoenn, Ash ventured to Sinnoh alone, where, in When Pokémon Worlds Collide!, he would meet , the daughter of a Top Coordinator wishing to follow in the footsteps of her mother. From that point, after saving Ash's Pikachu and having her bike fried in a similar way to May's and Misty's, Dawn would travel with Ash and Brock through Sinnoh, which she did until Memories are Made of Bliss! when all three friends split up.

Dawn rejoins Ash's group in Pokémon the Series: Black & White in Piplup, Pansage, and a Meeting of the Times! to compete in the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup. Dawn would leave the group in Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure! and travel to Johto to compete in the Wallace Cup. 

Having returned from her journey in Johto and around the world, she met up with Ash again in Pokémon Journeys: The Series during his research travel in Sinnoh with Goh to investigate and in Nightfall? Nightmares! and A Midsummer Night's Light!, also meeting Chloe before meeting them. She met up with them again in The Gates of Warp! and Showdown at the Gates of Warp!, helping to solve a crisis involving and . She reunited with Ash and Goh in The Arceus Chronicles (Part 1 through 4), and reunited with Ash and Chloe from A Flood of Torrential Gains! to Partners in Time!.

Pokémon
 
 

==Pokémon the Series: Black & White==
===Iris===
 
 

Iris is said to be a wild girl, as proven by the fact that she swings on vines. She decided to travel throughout Unova and the Decolore Islands with Ash from Enter Iris and Axew! until Best Wishes Until We Meet Again!

Her goal is to become a Dragon Master. She left the group in order to travel to Blackthorn City in the Johto region and challenge Clair, to gain more experience towards her goal. Iris returned in Thrash of the Titans!, where it was revealed she had unseated Alder to become the of the Unova League. She returned to participate in the Pokémon World Coronation Series Masters Eight Tournament from Curtain Up! Fight the Fights! to Battling as Hard as Stone!.

Pokémon
 
 

===Cilan===
 
 

Cilan, a Pokémon Connoisseur and one of the Gym Leaders of the Striaton City Gym, travels with and in their journey through Unova and the Decolore Islands from Dreams by the Yard Full! until Best Wishes Until We Meet Again!.

Cilan decided to depart from the group in order to further his skills as a Pokémon Connoisseur, starting by heading to Dewford Town to take part in a fishing tournament held by Mr. Briney. He reunited with Ash and and met for the first time in Must Be Our Heroes and the Witch!, where he also revealed to Ash that he was already acquainted with Brock.

Pokémon
 
 

==Pokémon the Series: XY==
===Clemont===
 
 

Clemont is an inventor Ash met after being ejected out of the Lumiose City Gym. His backpack, called the "Clemontic Gear", carries a variety of inventions and gadgets. He traveled with Ash from A Battle of Aerial Mobility! until The Future Is Now, Thanks to Determination!, then rejoined the group in The Moment of Lumiose Truth!, he decided to stay in Lumiose City in Till We Compete Again! when Ash returned to Kanto. He and Bonnie reunited with Ash in The Future is Now, Thanks to Strategy! and Taking Two For The Team!, while also meeting Goh for the first time.

Pokémon
 
 

===Bonnie===
 
 
Bonnie is Clemont's little sister. She is a young and cheerful girl, who despite being too young to officially train Pokémon, holds a great interest in them. She is proud of her big brother's accomplishments but is not above criticizing him. She started traveling with Ash in A Battle of Aerial Mobility! and stayed in Lumiose City with her brother when the group went their separate ways in Till We Compete Again!. She and Clemont reunited with Ash in The Future is Now, Thanks to Strategy! and Taking Two For The Team!, while also meeting Goh for the first time.

Pokémon
 
 

===Serena===
 
 

Serena is a Pokémon Trainer from Kalos who met Ash once before when they were younger. While the daughter of a famous racer, Serena eventually sets her goal to become . She started traveling with Ash in Giving Chase at the Rhyhorn Race! until Till We Compete Again! where she traveled to the Hoenn region to participate in Pokémon Contests in order to further her skills. As revealed in Pokémon Journeys: The Series, she has since become a rising star in the region, working her way to the Master Rank and cooperating with Lisia to liven up the local Contests.

While traveling with Ash, she cut her hair short and changed into her new outfit in A Showcase Debut!. She briefly reunited with Ash in Reuniting for the First Time!, while also meeting Goh for the first time.

Pokémon
 
 

==Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon==
===Lana===
 
 
Lana is one of Ash's classmates. She enjoys many seafaring activities such as fishing while riding on . She was the first of Ash's classmates in Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon series to meet Ash when she accidentally fished him up while he was riding on a . Lana remained in Alola to accompany her father in a fishing survey to research in Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!. Lana reunited with Ash in That New Old Gang of Mine!, where she also met Goh for the first time. She returned again in Helping the Hometown Hero!.

Pokémon
 
 

===Kiawe===
 
 
Kiawe is one of Ash's classmates. He is very gruff compared to his classmates and makes deliveries between islands on his . Ash first spotted Kiawe flying on his Charizard when he was lost in a forest. They formally met while Kiawe was in a battle with Team Skull and Ash joined in, making Kiawe the last of Ash's classmates Ash would meet. Kiawe remained in Alola in Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues! to resume his island challenge, with the goal of becoming Akala Island's next island kahuna and following in his grandfather's footsteps. Kiawe reunited with Ash in That New Old Gang of Mine!, where he also met Goh for the first time. He returned again in Helping the Hometown Hero!.

Pokémon
 
 

===Lillie===
 
 
Lillie is one of Ash's classmates. Prior to Lillie's Egg-xhilarating Challenge!, she was terrified of physically interacting with Pokémon, and tended to freeze up whenever one Pokémon entered her personal space. She was the second of Ash's classmates he would meet. She was watching a race between , and as Ash accidentally stumbled upon the racing track and spotted Lillie on the other side. They became classmates when Ash enrolled himself at the Pokémon School shortly thereafter.

Over the course of the series, Lillie adopted her first Pokémon, Snowy, overcame her fear of Pokémon, and reaffirmed her family bonds with her older brother , her estranged mother , and learned more about her long-missing father, Mohn. In Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!, Lillie left with her family on a journey in search of Mohn. She found her father in the Crown Tundra and reunited with Ash in The Homecoming Crown!, while also meeting Goh and Chloe for the first time. Lillie returned home to Alola in the following episode with her family and friends.

Pokémon
 
 

===Sophocles===
 
 
Sophocles is one of Ash's classmates. He enjoys inventing helpful devices and machinery. He met Ash while he was having a race against and and they ran him over when he accidentally stumbled upon the track. They became classmates when Ash enrolled himself at the Pokémon School shortly thereafter. In Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!, Sophocles left to spend his vacation at Mossdeep City's Space Center. Sophocles reunited with Ash in That New Old Gang of Mine!, where he also met Goh for the first time. He reunited with them in Lighting the Way Home! and Helping the Hometown Hero!.

Pokémon
 
 

===Mallow===
 
 
Mallow is one of Ash's classmates. She is talented cook for both people and Pokémon, and is a self-proclaimed poster girl at her family's restaurant, Aina's Kitchen. She met Ash while she was having a race against and and they ran him over when he accidentally stumbled upon the track. They became classmates when Ash enrolled himself at the Pokémon School shortly thereafter. In Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!, Mallow remained in Alola, aiming to succeed her father as the Aina's Kitchen's owner and turn it into a place that caters to both humans and Pokémon. Mallow reunited with Ash in That New Old Gang of Mine!, where she also met Goh for the first time. She returned again in Helping the Hometown Hero!.

Pokémon
 
 

===Rotom Pokédex===
 
 
Rotom possessed Ash's newly acquired Alola Pokédex at the beginning of Loading the Dex!. Since then, it has accompanied Ash as one of his companions, with the hopes of fulfilling its dream of becoming the world's greatest Pokédex. In Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!, Rotom remained in Alola to work with the Aether Foundation at Aether Paradise. It reunited with Ash in That New Old Gang of Mine!, where it also met Goh for the first time.

 
 

==Pokémon Journeys: The Series==
===Goh===
 ]]
 
Goh is a who had a chance encounter with when he was younger. His goal as a Trainer is to catch Mew, and his dream is to eventually catch every Pokémon in existence. Goh first met in his hometown of Vermilion City in Legend? Go! Friends? Go!, while he was pursuing a during a Raid Battle, despite owning no Pokémon at the time. The duo later became Professor Cerise's research assistants. Goh later caught his first Pokémon and partner, , in Mind-Boggling Dynamax! during his first excursion to the Galar region. Goh has temporarily separated from Ash in Time After Time!, Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald!, Chasing to the Finish!, and Just a Scone's Throw From Here!. In Leaping Toward the Dream!, Goh joined the Project Mew research team in the hopes of furthering his dream. In This Could be the Start of Something Big!, Goh officially parted ways from Ash when he decided to tour different regions alone in order to become a stronger Trainer who can equal Mew.

 
 

===Chloe===
 ]]
 
Chloe is Professor Cerise's daughter and Ash and Goh's friend in . Chloe occasionally accompanies the boys during their research trips, with these occurrences happening much more frequently after she obtained her first Pokémon, .

Pokémon
 
 

==I Choose You!==
===Verity===
 ]]
 
Verity is one of 's traveling companions in I Choose You!, which is set in a continuity different from . She is a vibrant and ish Pokémon Trainer who seems to enjoy adventures. Her mother is a famous Trainer back in her home region of Sinnoh. Because of that, she expects a lot from Verity, which puts a lot of pressure on her. She met Ash when they were both chasing after an . She then joined him and Sorrel on a journey to the Raizen Mountains, where was said to live. After meeting Ho-Oh, Verity left Ash and Sorrel to continue on her own journey.

Pokémon
 
 

===Sorrel===
 ]]
 
Sorrel is one of 's traveling companions in I Choose You!, which is set in a continuity different from . He is a young whose goal is to become a Pokémon Professor. He is interested in Legendary Pokémon. He met Ash and Verity when he chased after an . Although he initially had no interest in interacting with them, he later met them again in a cave to shelter from some rain. The three Trainers became friends and decided to travel to the Raizen Mountains together, where was said to reside. After meeting Ho-Oh, Sorrel left Ash and Verity to go on his journey and meet more Legendary Pokémon.

Ritchie accompanied Ash, Misty, and Brock from The Mystery is History to A Promise is a Promise while he was searching for a mysterious Pokémon that can be found in the Whirl Islands, which turned out to be a .

Barry accompanied Ash, Brock, and Dawn from Barry's Busting Out All Over! until Jumping Rocket Ship! while Ash was trying to earn the . He then traveled with them to the Pokémon Ping Pong Tournament from Stopped in the Name of Love! until To Thine Own Pokémon Be True!.

Pokémon
 
 

===Zoey===
 ]]
 
Zoey accompanied Ash, Dawn, and Brock from Classroom Training! until A Pyramiding Rage! while the group was in Snowpoint City. During this time, she guided them around her hometown, watched Ash's Gym against Candice, and accompanied them to the Battle Pyramid.

Pokémon
 
 

===Lyra===
 
 
Lyra met Ash, Dawn, and Brock during the Johto Festival in An Egg Scramble!. She and Khoury accompanied them to Lilypad Town and left the group in Bagged then Tagged! when she returned to Johto.

Pokémon
 
 

===Khoury===
 ]]
 
Khoury met Ash, Dawn, and Brock during the Johto Festival when Lyra introduced them in An Egg Scramble!. He and Lyra accompanied them to Lilypad Town and left the group in Bagged then Tagged! when he returned to Johto.

Pokémon
 
 

===Cynthia===
 
 
Cynthia is the of the Sinnoh region. She assisted Ash and his friends in dealing with the Team Galactic crisis, and also accompanied Ash's group on the way to her villa in Undella Town.
Pokémon
 
 

===Bianca===
 
 
Bianca first met Ash in Minccino Neat And Tidy where she gave him his Badge case from Professor Juniper. She later accompanies him, Iris, and Cilan for a short time on their way to Nimbasa City. However, upon hearing that Ash had three Badges, she was inspired to catch up to him and left to collect Badges on her own. Since then, Bianca has temporarily joined the group numerous times during their journey from Emolga the Irresistible! until Emolga and the New Volt Switch!, then temporarily rejoined them from Crisis at Chargestone Cave! until Evolution Exchange Excitement!.

Pokémon
 
 

===Luke===
 ]]
 
Luke first met Ash, Iris, and Cilan in his hometown where they helped him produce a movie. At the end of Movie Time! Zorua in "The Legend of the Pokémon Knight"!, he accompanies them to Nimbasa Town, where he stays with them during the Club Battle tournament, before heading back home at the end of The Club Battle Finale: A Heroes Outcome!.

Pokémon
 
 

===Meowth===
 
 
After reportedly being "disbanded" from Team Rocket in Meowth's Scrafty Tactics!, Meowth was found unconscious by Ash's Tepig and Iris's Axew. The group nursed him back to health and invited him to accompany them so as to protect him from Trainers wanting to capture the only talking in Unova. He used his ability to speak to humans and Pokémon many times during their travels together.

He later revealed their travels to be a facade to gain their trust for a mission, and reunited with Jessie and James in Crisis from the Underground Up!.

 

===Stephan===
 ]]
 
Stephan decided to travel with Ash and co. in Climbing the Tower of Success! after taking part in a competition with them. He left the group after winning the Clubsplosion tournament in Commanding the Clubsplosion Crown!.

===Meloetta===
 
 
Meloetta decided to travel with Ash and his friends from Piplup, Pansage, and a Meeting of the Times! until Unova's Survival Crisis!.

 

===Cameron===
 
 
After Dawn left the group after the Junior Tournament, Cameron decided to join Ash, Iris, and Cilan. He left the group after he won his eighth and final Badge against Marlon from Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure! until The Road to Humilau!.

Pokémon

After meeting with Ash and the others again in Saving Braviary!, he agreed to travel with them to Driftveil City. After an encounter with Team Plasma, N was forced to leave the group in Secrets From Out of the Fog!.

 ]]
 
Alexa, a journalist from Kalos, met Ash and friends in The Journalist from Another Region! on Harvest Island. She traveled with the group through the Decolore Islands, and joined Ash on his journey to Kalos, but officially split with Ash in Kalos: Where Dreams and Adventures Begin! because her sister Viola was away from Santalune Gym.

Pokémon
 
 

===Korrina===
 
 
Korrina, the Shalour City Gym Leader, met Ash, Serena, Clemont, and Bonnie in Mega Revelations! on their way to her hometown. The group accompanied her as she traveled to Geosenge Town to understand and master the Mega Evolution of her trusted partner, . She left the group at Pomace Mountain in The Bonds of Mega Evolution!. In An Adventure of Mega Proportions!, she accompanied Ash and Goh to Mega Island in search of a Lucarionite for Ash's Lucario.

Pokémon
 
 

===Sawyer===
 ]]
 
Sawyer met Ash, Serena, and Bonnie in A Fashionable Battle! in the Laverre Gym, where he was asking for a Gym Battle with Valerie. He recognized Clemont as the Lumiose City Gym Leader, as he had had a Gym Battle with him in Battling with Elegance and a Big Smile!. He left the group in Rivals: Today and Tomorrow!.

In A Full-Strength Battle Surprise!, after battling Ash and winning, Sawyer decided to accompany him and his friends to Snowbelle City. In the following episode, he watched Ash battle Wulfric before leaving to train for the Lumiose Conference.

Pokémon
 
 

===Squishy===
 ]]
 
Squishy first met Ash and the group in From A to Z!. After saving it from Team Flare, the group took it with them with Bonnie taking care of it. Later, it left the group in Forming a More Perfect Union! and disappeared along with Z2.

 

===Professor Kukui===
 
 
Professor Kukui is the teacher of Ash's class in Pokémon School, and his caretaker while he stays in the Alola region. As teacher, Kukui often chaperones class trips.

By the end of Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon, Ash and his friends learn Professor Kukui is also The Masked Royal, the famous masked Trainer who fights in Battle Royals in the Battle Royal Dome with his partner .

Pokémon
 
 

===Olivia===
 ]]
 
Olivia is the island kahuna of Akala Island. She traveled with Ash, his classmates, and Professor Kukui during their first group trip to the island. In Currying Favor and Flavor!, she watched over Ash's trial in the Lush Forest. In the following episode, Ash battled Olivia in a grand trial Double Battle and won.

Pokémon
 
 

===Gladion===
 
 
Gladion is 's older brother, and Ash's rival in Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. In Revealing the Stuff of Legend!, Gladion and Lillie reunited with Ash and the rest of Lillie's friends, and joined forces to rescue , who had been abducted by a .

In Filling the Light with Darkness!, it was revealed that Gladion had joined the Ultra Guardians as its seventh member. Together with Ash and his classmates, they traveled to 's home world in Ultra Space, and were able to restore light to .

Pokémon
 
 

===Acerola===
 ]]
 
In Tough Guy Trials!, Ash and his Pokémon arrived alone on Ula'ula Island to challenge its grand trial. There, he met Acerola and the island kahuna, Nanu. After being defeated by Nanu, Acerola joined Ash to help him train for his upcoming rematch, following Ash's defeat at Nanu's hands in an unofficial battle. Once Ash eventually won the rematch, she said goodbye to him and promised to visit Melemele Island sometime.
Pokémon
 
 

===Dia===
 
 
In Battling the Beast Within!, Ash and Pikachu were sent to an alternate dimension Hau'oli City that had been devastated by a . A Trainer named and the he befriended saved Ash and Pikachu from being devoured by the Ultra Beast. With the help of their Pokémon and the Z-Power granted by the alternate Melemele Island's , Ash and Dia were able to send Guzzlord back to the world it came from.
Pokémon
 
 

===Shaymin===
 
 
Shaymin is a wild Pokémon that cared for. It first appeared in Memories in the Mist!, where it encountered Mallow after being drawn to her strong feelings of gratitude towards her late mother. Mallow then decided to take it in until the time came for it to turn into its and fly away. In Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!, Mallow's brother Ulu returned home, carrying flowers that turned out to be Gracideas, which allowed Shaymin to change into its Sky Forme and fly away.

 

===Leon===
 
 
 is the current of the Galar region and the former Monarch of the World Coronation Series. Leon initially joined Ash and traveled to various locations to stop the Darkest Day, and would once again join him for a training session in the Wild Area.

Pokémon
 
 

==In the spin-off games==
===Pokémon Puzzle League===
In Pokémon Puzzle League, some available player characters include , , , Tracey Sketchit, and Ritchie.

===Sega Pico series===
In Pokémon Advanced Generation: Pico for Everyone Pokémon Loud Battle! and Pokémon Advanced Generation: Pokémon Number Battle!, , , , and Max appear as a group. In both games, the available mini-games represent Ash's friends battling against the Team Rocket trio. In Pico for Everyone Pokémon Loud Battle!, they are referred to as Ash Team (Japanese: サトシチーム Satoshi Team).

==Trivia==
All first partner Pokémon (prior to Generation IX) have been owned by or one of his friends.
Alexa is the only human companion, main or temporary, to accompany Ash through the end of one series to the start of the next.
and Goh are the only companions to share the role of protagonist with Ash during their time on the main cast.
is the only one of Ash's friends that Ash has met prior to the beginning of the series.
is the first of Ash's friends that has left the group in the middle of a journey.
May and Max are the only companions that Ash did not reunite with in .
May is the first one of Ash's companions to be based on a player character, while Serena is the last one of Ash's companions to be based on a player character.
Ash's Alolan classmates are the first main characters to not appear in every episode between their debut and their departure from the main cast.
They are also the first main characters to not appear in any Pokémon movies.
Goh is the first of Ash's friends to have a rivalry with one of Ash's .
Goh is also the only one of Ash's friends to leave the group during a major tournament arc.
Eevee and its Evolutions are the most frequently occurring Pokémon to be caught amongst Ash's traveling companions, with four of them capturing one each, and another one being captured by two temporary traveling companions.

sections.text:
Brock first joined Ash in Showdown in Pewter City after Ash d him in the Pewter City Gym. After his father offered to take over the duties of Gym Leader, Brock followed Ash through Kanto, leaving briefly from Poké Ball Peril to A Tent Situation to work for Professor Ivy. In The Rivalry Revival, Brock returned to be with Ash and until Gotta Catch Ya Later!, though he, unlike Misty, would return shortly, in You Can Never Taillow, sticking with Ash until Home is Where the Start is!. He would again return in Two Degrees of Separation!, and so traveled through Sinnoh with Ash until Memories are Made of Bliss!. He and Misty also appeared in Alola, Kanto! and When Regions Collide!, where Ash and his classmates from Pokémon School visited Kanto, and returned in Alola, Alola! and Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone!, where he and Misty visited Alola. Brock reunited with Ash and Dawn in The Arceus Chronicles (Parts 2 to 4), while also meeting Goh for the first time. He reunited with Ash and Misty again in Must Be Our Heroes and the Witch! and all of them decided to travel with each other again until The Rainbow and the Pokémon Master!.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Tracey Sketchit
sections.text:
After left to work for Professor Ivy, Ash's traveling group was down to two, as it had been for the first five episodes of Kanto. However, this would not last very long, as in The Lost Lapras Ash met a Pokémon Watcher named who essentially invited himself along for the rest of the Orange Islands saga. Traveling with Ash, he wished to attain his ultimate goal of meeting , which he did when Ash returned to Kanto in A Tent Situation. After this, he remained in Pallet Town to be Professor Oak's assistant in The Rivalry Revival. Ash has reunited with Tracey during his visits to Pallet Town in Gotta Catch Ya Later!, The Right Place and the Right Mime, Home is Where the Start Is!, and The Rainbow and the Pokémon Master!.

Pokémon

sections.heading: May
sections.text:
Ash may have traveled to Hoenn alone; however, shortly after his arrival, he met , a young girl who desired to travel around the world and a fellow Trainer who was just starting her journey and then ended up destroying her bike just like that of Misty. Though she initially did not care for , she eventually found Pokémon Contests, in which she competed while in Hoenn and then later in Kanto. May traveled with Ash through the entire Advanced Generation saga, from Get the Show on the Road to Home is Where the Start Is!, after which she went off to Johto to compete in Contests there. She, like , reappeared briefly during Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl to compete in the Wallace Cup from A Full Course Tag Battle! until Strategy with a Smile!.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Max
sections.text:
]]
 
Max is 's younger brother. He does not have any Pokémon of his own because he is too young, but he often befriends certain Pokémon. He traveled with the group from There's no Place Like Hoenn until Home is Where the Start Is, when he went home to Petalburg City. However, he made a promise to Ash that as soon as he got his own Pokémon, he would Ash.

sections.heading: Dawn
sections.text:
Like his journey into Hoenn, Ash ventured to Sinnoh alone, where, in When Pokémon Worlds Collide!, he would meet , the daughter of a Top Coordinator wishing to follow in the footsteps of her mother. From that point, after saving Ash's Pikachu and having her bike fried in a similar way to May's and Misty's, Dawn would travel with Ash and Brock through Sinnoh, which she did until Memories are Made of Bliss! when all three friends split up.

Dawn rejoins Ash's group in Pokémon the Series: Black & White in Piplup, Pansage, and a Meeting of the Times! to compete in the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup. Dawn would leave the group in Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure! and travel to Johto to compete in the Wallace Cup. 

Having returned from her journey in Johto and around the world, she met up with Ash again in Pokémon Journeys: The Series during his research travel in Sinnoh with Goh to investigate and in Nightfall? Nightmares! and A Midsummer Night's Light!, also meeting Chloe before meeting them. She met up with them again in The Gates of Warp! and Showdown at the Gates of Warp!, helping to solve a crisis involving and . She reunited with Ash and Goh in The Arceus Chronicles (Part 1 through 4), and reunited with Ash and Chloe from A Flood of Torrential Gains! to Partners in Time!.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Iris
sections.text:
Iris is said to be a wild girl, as proven by the fact that she swings on vines. She decided to travel throughout Unova and the Decolore Islands with Ash from Enter Iris and Axew! until Best Wishes Until We Meet Again!

Her goal is to become a Dragon Master. She left the group in order to travel to Blackthorn City in the Johto region and challenge Clair, to gain more experience towards her goal. Iris returned in Thrash of the Titans!, where it was revealed she had unseated Alder to become the of the Unova League. She returned to participate in the Pokémon World Coronation Series Masters Eight Tournament from Curtain Up! Fight the Fights! to Battling as Hard as Stone!.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Cilan
sections.text:
Cilan, a Pokémon Connoisseur and one of the Gym Leaders of the Striaton City Gym, travels with and in their journey through Unova and the Decolore Islands from Dreams by the Yard Full! until Best Wishes Until We Meet Again!.

Cilan decided to depart from the group in order to further his skills as a Pokémon Connoisseur, starting by heading to Dewford Town to take part in a fishing tournament held by Mr. Briney. He reunited with Ash and and met for the first time in Must Be Our Heroes and the Witch!, where he also revealed to Ash that he was already acquainted with Brock.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Clemont
sections.text:
Clemont is an inventor Ash met after being ejected out of the Lumiose City Gym. His backpack, called the "Clemontic Gear", carries a variety of inventions and gadgets. He traveled with Ash from A Battle of Aerial Mobility! until The Future Is Now, Thanks to Determination!, then rejoined the group in The Moment of Lumiose Truth!, he decided to stay in Lumiose City in Till We Compete Again! when Ash returned to Kanto. He and Bonnie reunited with Ash in The Future is Now, Thanks to Strategy! and Taking Two For The Team!, while also meeting Goh for the first time.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Bonnie
sections.text:
Bonnie is Clemont's little sister. She is a young and cheerful girl, who despite being too young to officially train Pokémon, holds a great interest in them. She is proud of her big brother's accomplishments but is not above criticizing him. She started traveling with Ash in A Battle of Aerial Mobility! and stayed in Lumiose City with her brother when the group went their separate ways in Till We Compete Again!. She and Clemont reunited with Ash in The Future is Now, Thanks to Strategy! and Taking Two For The Team!, while also meeting Goh for the first time.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Serena
sections.text:
Serena is a Pokémon Trainer from Kalos who met Ash once before when they were younger. While the daughter of a famous racer, Serena eventually sets her goal to become . She started traveling with Ash in Giving Chase at the Rhyhorn Race! until Till We Compete Again! where she traveled to the Hoenn region to participate in Pokémon Contests in order to further her skills. As revealed in Pokémon Journeys: The Series, she has since become a rising star in the region, working her way to the Master Rank and cooperating with Lisia to liven up the local Contests.

While traveling with Ash, she cut her hair short and changed into her new outfit in A Showcase Debut!. She briefly reunited with Ash in Reuniting for the First Time!, while also meeting Goh for the first time.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Lana
sections.text:
Lana is one of Ash's classmates. She enjoys many seafaring activities such as fishing while riding on . She was the first of Ash's classmates in Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon series to meet Ash when she accidentally fished him up while he was riding on a . Lana remained in Alola to accompany her father in a fishing survey to research in Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!. Lana reunited with Ash in That New Old Gang of Mine!, where she also met Goh for the first time. She returned again in Helping the Hometown Hero!.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Kiawe
sections.text:
Kiawe is one of Ash's classmates. He is very gruff compared to his classmates and makes deliveries between islands on his . Ash first spotted Kiawe flying on his Charizard when he was lost in a forest. They formally met while Kiawe was in a battle with Team Skull and Ash joined in, making Kiawe the last of Ash's classmates Ash would meet. Kiawe remained in Alola in Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues! to resume his island challenge, with the goal of becoming Akala Island's next island kahuna and following in his grandfather's footsteps. Kiawe reunited with Ash in That New Old Gang of Mine!, where he also met Goh for the first time. He returned again in Helping the Hometown Hero!.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Lillie
sections.text:
Lillie is one of Ash's classmates. Prior to Lillie's Egg-xhilarating Challenge!, she was terrified of physically interacting with Pokémon, and tended to freeze up whenever one Pokémon entered her personal space. She was the second of Ash's classmates he would meet. She was watching a race between , and as Ash accidentally stumbled upon the racing track and spotted Lillie on the other side. They became classmates when Ash enrolled himself at the Pokémon School shortly thereafter.

Over the course of the series, Lillie adopted her first Pokémon, Snowy, overcame her fear of Pokémon, and reaffirmed her family bonds with her older brother , her estranged mother , and learned more about her long-missing father, Mohn. In Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!, Lillie left with her family on a journey in search of Mohn. She found her father in the Crown Tundra and reunited with Ash in The Homecoming Crown!, while also meeting Goh and Chloe for the first time. Lillie returned home to Alola in the following episode with her family and friends.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Sophocles
sections.text:
Sophocles is one of Ash's classmates. He enjoys inventing helpful devices and machinery. He met Ash while he was having a race against and and they ran him over when he accidentally stumbled upon the track. They became classmates when Ash enrolled himself at the Pokémon School shortly thereafter. In Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!, Sophocles left to spend his vacation at Mossdeep City's Space Center. Sophocles reunited with Ash in That New Old Gang of Mine!, where he also met Goh for the first time. He reunited with them in Lighting the Way Home! and Helping the Hometown Hero!.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Mallow
sections.text:
Mallow is one of Ash's classmates. She is talented cook for both people and Pokémon, and is a self-proclaimed poster girl at her family's restaurant, Aina's Kitchen. She met Ash while she was having a race against and and they ran him over when he accidentally stumbled upon the track. They became classmates when Ash enrolled himself at the Pokémon School shortly thereafter. In Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!, Mallow remained in Alola, aiming to succeed her father as the Aina's Kitchen's owner and turn it into a place that caters to both humans and Pokémon. Mallow reunited with Ash in That New Old Gang of Mine!, where she also met Goh for the first time. She returned again in Helping the Hometown Hero!.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Rotom Pokédex
sections.text: Rotom possessed Ash's newly acquired Alola Pokédex at the beginning of Loading the Dex!. Since then, it has accompanied Ash as one of his companions, with the hopes of fulfilling its dream of becoming the world's greatest Pokédex. In Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!, Rotom remained in Alola to work with the Aether Foundation at Aether Paradise. It reunited with Ash in That New Old Gang of Mine!, where it also met Goh for the first time.

sections.heading: Goh
sections.text:
]]
 
Goh is a who had a chance encounter with when he was younger. His goal as a Trainer is to catch Mew, and his dream is to eventually catch every Pokémon in existence. Goh first met in his hometown of Vermilion City in Legend? Go! Friends? Go!, while he was pursuing a during a Raid Battle, despite owning no Pokémon at the time. The duo later became Professor Cerise's research assistants. Goh later caught his first Pokémon and partner, , in Mind-Boggling Dynamax! during his first excursion to the Galar region. Goh has temporarily separated from Ash in Time After Time!, Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald!, Chasing to the Finish!, and Just a Scone's Throw From Here!. In Leaping Toward the Dream!, Goh joined the Project Mew research team in the hopes of furthering his dream. In This Could be the Start of Something Big!, Goh officially parted ways from Ash when he decided to tour different regions alone in order to become a stronger Trainer who can equal Mew.

sections.heading: Chloe
Verity
Sorrel
Haunter
sections.text: Haunter briefly accompanied Ash from The Tower of Terror to Haunter versus Kadabra, helping Ash in the Gym battle against Sabrina before it was left with her.

sections.heading: Todd Snap
sections.text: Todd Snap accompanied Ash, Misty, and Brock from Pokémon Paparazzi to The Breeding Center Secret. He later meets up with Ash again in Moving Pictures during his journey through Johto, trying to take a photograph of the legendary . They meet an elderly couple celebrating their 50th wedding anniversary, and Todd has the honor of taking their anniversary photo for them. Later on, in Freeze Frame Todd finally finds Articuno and manages to get a photograph of it. He then departs from the group once more.

sections.heading: Ritchie
Mr. Briney
Professor Birch
Cheryl
Barry
sections.text:
Barry accompanied Ash, Brock, and Dawn from Barry's Busting Out All Over! until Jumping Rocket Ship! while Ash was trying to earn the . He then traveled with them to the Pokémon Ping Pong Tournament from Stopped in the Name of Love! until To Thine Own Pokémon Be True!.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Zoey
Lyra
sections.text:
Lyra met Ash, Dawn, and Brock during the Johto Festival in An Egg Scramble!. She and Khoury accompanied them to Lilypad Town and left the group in Bagged then Tagged! when she returned to Johto.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Khoury
Cynthia
sections.text:
Cynthia is the of the Sinnoh region. She assisted Ash and his friends in dealing with the Team Galactic crisis, and also accompanied Ash's group on the way to her villa in Undella Town.
Pokémon

sections.heading: Bianca
sections.text:
Bianca first met Ash in Minccino Neat And Tidy where she gave him his Badge case from Professor Juniper. She later accompanies him, Iris, and Cilan for a short time on their way to Nimbasa City. However, upon hearing that Ash had three Badges, she was inspired to catch up to him and left to collect Badges on her own. Since then, Bianca has temporarily joined the group numerous times during their journey from Emolga the Irresistible! until Emolga and the New Volt Switch!, then temporarily rejoined them from Crisis at Chargestone Cave! until Evolution Exchange Excitement!.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Luke
Meowth
sections.text:
After reportedly being "disbanded" from Team Rocket in Meowth's Scrafty Tactics!, Meowth was found unconscious by Ash's Tepig and Iris's Axew. The group nursed him back to health and invited him to accompany them so as to protect him from Trainers wanting to capture the only talking in Unova. He used his ability to speak to humans and Pokémon many times during their travels together.

He later revealed their travels to be a facade to gain their trust for a mission, and reunited with Jessie and James in Crisis from the Underground Up!.

sections.heading: Stephan
Meloetta
sections.text: Meloetta decided to travel with Ash and his friends from Piplup, Pansage, and a Meeting of the Times! until Unova's Survival Crisis!.

sections.heading: Cameron
sections.text:
After Dawn left the group after the Junior Tournament, Cameron decided to join Ash, Iris, and Cilan. He left the group after he won his eighth and final Badge against Marlon from Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure! until The Road to Humilau!.

Pokémon

sections.heading: N
sections.text: After meeting with Ash and the others again in Saving Braviary!, he agreed to travel with them to Driftveil City. After an encounter with Team Plasma, N was forced to leave the group in Secrets From Out of the Fog!.

sections.heading: Alexa
Korrina
sections.text:
Korrina, the Shalour City Gym Leader, met Ash, Serena, Clemont, and Bonnie in Mega Revelations! on their way to her hometown. The group accompanied her as she traveled to Geosenge Town to understand and master the Mega Evolution of her trusted partner, . She left the group at Pomace Mountain in The Bonds of Mega Evolution!. In An Adventure of Mega Proportions!, she accompanied Ash and Goh to Mega Island in search of a Lucarionite for Ash's Lucario.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Sawyer
sections.text:
]]
 
Sawyer met Ash, Serena, and Bonnie in A Fashionable Battle! in the Laverre Gym, where he was asking for a Gym Battle with Valerie. He recognized Clemont as the Lumiose City Gym Leader, as he had had a Gym Battle with him in Battling with Elegance and a Big Smile!. He left the group in Rivals: Today and Tomorrow!.

In A Full-Strength Battle Surprise!, after battling Ash and winning, Sawyer decided to accompany him and his friends to Snowbelle City. In the following episode, he watched Ash battle Wulfric before leaving to train for the Lumiose Conference.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Squishy
sections.text:
]]
 
Squishy first met Ash and the group in From A to Z!. After saving it from Team Flare, the group took it with them with Bonnie taking care of it. Later, it left the group in Forming a More Perfect Union! and disappeared along with Z2.

sections.heading: Professor Kukui
sections.text:
Professor Kukui is the teacher of Ash's class in Pokémon School, and his caretaker while he stays in the Alola region. As teacher, Kukui often chaperones class trips.

By the end of Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon, Ash and his friends learn Professor Kukui is also The Masked Royal, the famous masked Trainer who fights in Battle Royals in the Battle Royal Dome with his partner .

Pokémon

sections.heading: Olivia
Gladion
sections.text:
Gladion is 's older brother, and Ash's rival in Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. In Revealing the Stuff of Legend!, Gladion and Lillie reunited with Ash and the rest of Lillie's friends, and joined forces to rescue , who had been abducted by a .

In Filling the Light with Darkness!, it was revealed that Gladion had joined the Ultra Guardians as its seventh member. Together with Ash and his classmates, they traveled to 's home world in Ultra Space, and were able to restore light to .

Pokémon

sections.heading: Acerola
Dia
sections.text:
In Battling the Beast Within!, Ash and Pikachu were sent to an alternate dimension Hau'oli City that had been devastated by a . A Trainer named and the he befriended saved Ash and Pikachu from being devoured by the Ultra Beast. With the help of their Pokémon and the Z-Power granted by the alternate Melemele Island's , Ash and Dia were able to send Guzzlord back to the world it came from.
Pokémon

sections.heading: Shaymin
sections.text: Shaymin is a wild Pokémon that cared for. It first appeared in Memories in the Mist!, where it encountered Mallow after being drawn to her strong feelings of gratitude towards her late mother. Mallow then decided to take it in until the time came for it to turn into its and fly away. In Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!, Mallow's brother Ulu returned home, carrying flowers that turned out to be Gracideas, which allowed Shaymin to change into its Sky Forme and fly away.

sections.heading: Leon
sections.text:
is the current of the Galar region and the former Monarch of the World Coronation Series. Leon initially joined Ash and traveled to various locations to stop the Darkest Day, and would once again join him for a training session in the Wild Area.

Pokémon

sections.heading: Pokémon Puzzle League
sections.text: In Pokémon Puzzle League, some available player characters include , , , Tracey Sketchit, and Ritchie.

sections.heading: Sega Pico series
sections.text: In Pokémon Advanced Generation: Pico for Everyone Pokémon Loud Battle! and Pokémon Advanced Generation: Pokémon Number Battle!, , , , and Max appear as a group. In both games, the available mini-games represent Ash's friends battling against the Team Rocket trio. In Pico for Everyone Pokémon Loud Battle!, they are referred to as Ash Team (Japanese: サトシチーム Satoshi Team).

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
All first partner Pokémon (prior to Generation IX) have been owned by or one of his friends.
Alexa is the only human companion, main or temporary, to accompany Ash through the end of one series to the start of the next.
and Goh are the only companions to share the role of protagonist with Ash during their time on the main cast.
is the only one of Ash's friends that Ash has met prior to the beginning of the series.
is the first of Ash's friends that has left the group in the middle of a journey.
May and Max are the only companions that Ash did not reunite with in .
May is the first one of Ash's companions to be based on a player character, while Serena is the last one of Ash's companions to be based on a player character.
Ash's Alolan classmates are the first main characters to not appear in every episode between their debut and their departure from the main cast.
They are also the first main characters to not appear in any Pokémon movies.
Goh is the first of Ash's friends to have a rivalry with one of Ash's .
Goh is also the only one of Ash's friends to leave the group during a major tournament arc.
Eevee and its Evolutions are the most frequently occurring Pokémon to be caught amongst Ash's traveling companions, with four of them capturing one each, and another one being captured by two temporary traveling companions.

aiReadySummary.title: Ash's friends
aiReadySummary.searchableText:
Ash's friends
Category:Ash's friends
This article is about Ash's main and temporary traveling companions. If you were looking for a general list of people Ash has met on his journey, see Character of the day.
----
 
Ash's friends are the traveling companions that Ash Ketchum has had with him on his quest to become a Pokémon Master. While he started his alone, many people have joined his party while touring the Pokémon world; usually, at least one new companion joins—and another leaves—every time a new series begins.

Throughout their journey together, Ash and his friends will sometimes be accompanied by temporary companions, who travel with the group for a few episodes without officially joining the main cast. Likewise, Ash also reunites with his previous friends on occasion, who often temporarily rejoin him before parting ways with him again.

In , Ash's friends are not traveling companions, but rather classmates, since Ash is attending the Pokémon School instead of traveling around the Alola region. Later in the series, Ash and his Alolan friends form a team under the supervision of Aether Foundation, known as the Ultra Guardians.
